intervals.quote: The data analysed in this work were collected in the year 2021 during the first, seven-week-long physics run of MEG II

intervals.label: high-statistics data taking
intervals.quote: A ten-fold larger sample of data is being collected during the years 2022-2023, and data-taking will continue in the coming years.

name: MEG II detector
notes: The technology class is 'other', matching detector:meg: no liquid-xenon scintillation calorimeter class exists among the available technology classes.

summary.plain: The upgraded version of the MEG detector: a finer liquid-xenon calorimeter and new tracking and timing detectors, at the same Swiss laboratory, still taking data.
summary.technical: Upgrade of the MEG detector: higher-granularity LXe calorimeter, single-volume cylindrical drift chamber (replacing MEG's drift chamber array), upgraded plastic-scintillator timing counter and a new radiative decay counter (RDC) for normalization, on the PSI piE5 beamline. First physics run 2021, ongoing data-taking through at least 2023 per the most recent source consulted. No separately sourced subsystem dimensions are recorded.

technology.quote: newly designed single-volume cylindrical drift chamber (CDCH) ... a new pixelated timing counter (pTC) based on scintillator tiles read out by SiPMs ... measured by an upgraded LXe photon detector. ... the Radiative Decay Counter (RDC)
technology.value: Upgraded liquid xenon calorimeter with finer granularity, a new single-volume cylindrical drift chamber, upgraded timing counter and a new radiative decay counter, on the same PSI DC muon beamline
